turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr./Ms. [Name]. I'm [Provider's Name], the anesthesiologist who'll be taking care of you during your knee surgery tomorrow. Let's go over some details to ensure everything is in order. How have you been feeling lately?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Morning, doc. Been managing okay lah, but this left knee is really giving me trouble. Can't walk far without pain, even with the brace.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: I see. How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and has there been any recent worsening?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: About 2 years now, but last 6 months it's gotten much worse. Can't even climb stairs properly, you know?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Let's move to your medications. I see you're on Metformin, Amlodipine, Metoprolol, Atorvastatin, and Lisinopril. Are all these still active, or have there been any changes recently?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Ah, actually, doc. I stopped Lisinopril about 6 months ago. Had a bad dry cough from it, couldn't sleep. Doctor said to stop and switch to something else, but I think the records might still show it as active?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for clarifying that. So, to confirm: you're no longer on Lisinopril, and your current active medications are Metformin, Amlodipine, Metoprolol, and Atorvastatin?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, that's right. The cough went away after stopping Lisinopril, and the other meds are all still going strong.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent, that's important to note. Any known allergies to medications or other substances?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: None that I know of, doc. Never had a reaction to anything.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Have you had anything to eat or drink since midnight? We need to confirm your NPO status.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, nothing since 12am. Just a sip of water for meds this morning, like you instructed.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect. Have you had any prior surgeries or anesthesia? Any complications in the past?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Had a hernia surgery years back. Anesthesia was fine then, no issues. Woke up feeling okay lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. Lastly, how would you describe your overall fitness? Can you walk with assistance, climb stairs, or do you need a wheelchair?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: With the knee brace and a walking stick, I can manage short distances. But without it, it's really painful. Can't do stairs at all now.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for sharing that. We'll plan for general anesthesia with a femoral nerve block to manage your pain during and after surgery. Your blood pressure medications will continue as usual, and we'll monitor your diabetes closely. Any questions for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No questions, doc. Just want to get this sorted so I can walk properly again. Thanks for listening.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Of course, Mr./Ms. [Name]. We'll take good care of you. I'll see you in the pre-op area tomorrow. Rest well tonight.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Will do, doc. Appreciate it.
